
```{r}
#| label: baseline-z
#| fig-height: 5
zp <- ggplot(kept, aes(x = baseline_z, y = fct_reorder(dataset, baseline_z, .fun = median))) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = c(-2, 2), linetype = "dashed", colour = alz_red) +
  geom_jitter(height = 0.2, alpha = 0.25, size = 0.5, colour = alz_blue) +
  labs(x = "Pre-stimulus SD (z, within subject)", y = NULL,
       subtitle = "Dashed lines: the |z| > 2 flagging cutoff") +
  alz_theme()
print(zp)
```
